Findings triage + claim (first grade and dispatch in one round, PM session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`): **PROMOTED and dispatched** (M). Branch: `claude/issue-4658-dead-locale-keys`.

Graded scope, taking the card's own "gate-first" suggestion in its measured form: build the reverse sweep as a **report-only** script (pack key set minus referenced key set, reusing the call-site gate's existing key-resolution machinery, with the dynamic-key namespaces it already understands treated as live) — not a red gate yet, because template-built keys make false positives structurally possible and a gate that cries wolf gets deleted. Let the report produce the full dead-key list, sample-verify hits, delete the confirmed-dead set across all ten packs (the five named here at minimum — the three `console.objectView.*` keys are permanently dead post-retirement, not merely dormant), and record the measured false-positive rate in the PR body as the input to a future enforce decision. PR will be `Fixes #4658`.
